text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A 12-member Austrian trade team to meet Bahraini businessmen on Monday. Bahrain's imports from Austria last year were worth 3.7 million dinars.
- Local consumption of petroleum products rose 4.6 percent in the first quarter of 1997 and fuel sales of the Bahrain Aviation Fueling Company grew 7.7 percent.
- A Bahraini high-level delegation leaves for Moscow on an official visit to boost trade links.
- Bahrain and Malaysia agree to link their bourses during a meeting in Kuala Lumpur.
